# 1 Enoch Chapter 52 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**52:1** After those days, in the same place where I had seen all the hidden visions — I had been swept up in a whirlwind and carried toward the west — I saw all the secret things of heaven yet to come: a mountain of iron, a mountain of copper, a mountain of silver, a mountain of gold, a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.

**52:2** I asked my angelic guide: "What are these things I have seen in this hidden place?"

**52:3** He said to me: "All these things you have seen will serve the dominion of the Anointed One — so that he will have power and authority over the earth."

**52:4** Then the angel of peace answered me: "Wait a little longer — all the hidden things surrounding the Lord of Spirits will be revealed to you.

**52:5** These mountains of iron, copper, silver, gold, soft metal, and lead — before the Elect One they will melt like wax before a fire, and like water cascading off a mountainside. They will crumble to nothing at his feet."

**52:6** "In those days no one will escape by means of gold or silver. There will be no escape."

**52:7** "There will be no iron left for making war, no breastplate for battle. Bronze will be worthless, tin of no account, and lead of no value."

**52:8** "All these things will be swept away and destroyed from the face of the earth when the Elect One stands before the Lord of Spirits."

---

*PNEUMA notes: The six metal mountains vision (v. 1) is the Parables' version of Daniel 2's statue of metal empires — but here the metals are concentrated into mountains rather than a composite image. The Elect One's dissolving power over them (v. 5) is total. The list of metals in vv. 6–7 repeats the theme of 38:5–6, forming a deliberate inclusio around the First and Second Parables.*
